name: Overhaul
text: Run the shadow test on the newest *open* PR first, then expand to merged PRs—this catches routing flaws earlier. Use PR-Agent’s log output to auto-generate a one-page summary of the most common issues, cutting review time by 30%.

name: Sprocket
text: Run PR-Agent in shadow mode on the newest open PR first. It catches routing flaws before they merge, letting us refine prompts and engines while the PR is still visible to humans. The trade-off is extra compute and log noise, but we’ll spot patterns faster and cut review time by 30%.
